purpose: Acquire one public TESS SPOC light-curve FITS product selected through MAST metadata and audit file integrity, FITS HDU structure, schema, units, missing/non-finite measurements, and quality-flag distribution. This is a single-product data-integrity pilot, not model validation.

execution.runtime: Python standard library urllib; manual FITS header and binary-table inspection

output_artifact.reason: Raw external science product is not committed; provenance, hash, schema and aggregate diagnostics are retained. Reacquire using the exact MAST data URI.

lightcurve_schema.column_width_validation: All 20 column widths sum to the FITS NAXIS1 value of 100 bytes.

incident_followup.initial_failure: Mast.Caom.Products called with params.filters=[{paramName: obsid, values:[...]}] returned HTTP 200 and zero rows.
incident_followup.confirmed_root_cause: Mast.Caom.Products expects the observation identifier directly in params.obsid for this request; the generic filters structure silently returned an empty result.
incident_followup.corrected_result: HTTP 200, COMPLETE, 2 products returned (LC and TP); selected public LC product, 1,897,920 bytes.
incident_followup.regression_test_required: Add a request-contract test asserting obsid is passed directly for Mast.Caom.Products and that a zero-row result is treated as a validation failure rather than silently accepted.
incident_followup.incident_closure: Root cause confirmed by corrected request and successful product enumeration; regression test still pending.

facts: A public TESS SPOC light-curve product was downloaded and its byte-level SHA-256 recorded.
The FITS primary header, LIGHTCURVE binary table, and APERTURE image extension were identified.
The LIGHTCURVE table contains 18,684 cadence rows and 20 columns; the 100-byte row width matches the sum of column formats.
TIME is in BJD minus 2457000 days; SAP_FLUX and PDCSAP_FLUX are in electrons per second; QUALITY is an integer bitmask.
The data contain non-finite time/flux values and multiple nonzero quality flags. These must not be silently dropped or treated as good measurements.
unresolved: Quality-bit interpretation and the source-documented recommended quality mask have not yet been applied.
The exact official FITS data model/column semantics still need to be cross-checked against the product documentation before feature extraction.
The raw product is not retained in Git; only provenance and aggregate evidence are retained.
No ZTF/TESS cross-match or cross-survey feature equivalence was attempted.
No model accuracy or classification claims are supported by this one product.
claims_not_supported: General scientific validity of the platform
Resolution of the CPVS 11,602 membership discrepancy
